transcript.content: Hello, and welcome. I'm Dr. [Name], a psychiatrist. What brings you in to see me today?

Hello, Doctor. Well, what made me come in today is that my eating has just gotten all turned around lately. Some days I completely forget to eat lunch altogether. And then other days... I just find myself standing at the kitchen counter eating crackers and sweets, even though nothing really tastes right to me.
Over the past few weeks, have you been feeling persistently sad, empty, or down most of the day?
Yes, I have. Most mornings I just wake up with this... well, a very heavy, low feeling. It's like the color has already gone out of the day before I even manage to get dressed.
Have you experienced periods like this before in your life, where you felt this persistent sadness and heaviness for an extended time?

No, I don't believe so. I mean, I've had normal ups and downs over the years, like anyone else, but... not quite like this. This kind of heavy feeling that just stays with me day after day, that's really not something I've dealt with before in my life.
Besides the heavy feeling and sadness you've described, have you been experiencing a lot of worry, anxiety, or nervousness? And if so, what kinds of things have you been worried about?

No, not really. I mean, I'm not feeling particularly anxious or nervous about anything specific. It's really just that heavy, sad feeling I mentioned. I don't sit around worrying, I just... I just feel very down.

When you mentioned having 'normal ups and downs' over the years, can you tell me more about that? Have you ever had a period lasting at least two weeks where you felt depressed or lost interest in things you normally enjoy?

Well, as for the ups and downs, I just meant the usual things people go through. But... this recent period is different. It's not just feeling sad. I've really lost interest in things I used to enjoy. I used to look forward to my watercolor class, the quilting circle, and my book club. I'd have everything ready to go. But lately... I often just leave my bag sitting by the door. I just can't seem to make myself care enough to actually go anymore. It's been like that for a few weeks now.

When you think back over your entire life before this recent period, have you ever had a time lasting at least two weeks where you felt depressed or down, and lost interest in things you normally enjoyed, similar to what you're experiencing now?

No, I really don't think so. Looking back over my whole life... no. I've never had a stretch of weeks where I just stopped caring about my hobbies or felt this low. Like I said, I've just had the normal things everyone goes through. This is really the first time it's ever been like this for me.

You mentioned this heavy feeling and loss of interest in your hobbies has been going on for a few weeks now. Can you be more specific about when this started? How many weeks or months ago would you say this began?

Well, I know I said a few weeks, but I guess... I mean, that's just when I completely stopped going to my classes and started leaving my bag by the door. But if I really think about when this whole low, colorless stretch actually started, it's been a lot longer than that. It's really been with me for about a year and two months now. I just haven't felt right since then.

During your entire life, have you ever had a period lasting several days or longer where you felt unusually energetic, optimistic, or 'up' — where you needed less sleep than usual but still felt rested, or where your thoughts seemed to race faster than normal?

No, I can't say I've ever felt anything like that. I've never been someone who could just go without sleep, and I've certainly never felt unusually energetic or... or 'up' for days at a time. My thoughts don't really race, either. I've always just been pretty steady, until this last year or so. So, no, nothing like what you're describing.
